verses.verse:
ऋजुधैवत षड्जयोर्मध्ये भागास्त्रयो मताः।
प्रथमो धैवतः शुद्धो द्वितीयौ द्वौ निषादकौ।।२१।।
verses.text: Between ṛju Dhaivata and Ṣaḍja three parts are held: the first is śuddha Dhaivata, the second [and third] the two Niṣādas.

commentary.text: That is, between komal Dhaivata and tāra Ṣaḍja the wise should make three equal parts and place, in order, Dhaivata and the two Niṣādas.
